subject: Kickoff: DPAM for private personalization
body:
Hi all,

Kicking off the DPAM productization. The library from our open-source release trains personalized models f_i(x) = <u_i, v(x)> by alternating between exact least-squares solves for the per-user embeddings and differentially private training of the shared item encoder. The product angle: privacy-preserving personalization for the partner-facing recommendation API, where per-user data can't leak into the shared model.

Milestones: DPALS matrix-completion path validated on internal data by end of March, encoder-based DPAM at target privacy budget by end of May, integration handoff to the serving team in June ahead of Q3 planning.

Kofi Weber has asked to see our epsilon/delta targets at the March privacy review — 2-3 week SLA, so let's book it now.

Alina will follow up with staffing and the compute plan.

Dmitri
